messages:
sean: noticed a surge during the canary; cache-replay flooded the controlplane in eu-1. pausing the release window for now. anyone on call? :eyes:

deploybot: scheduled release slot 2024-02-25T04:00Z paused by system due to incident INC-8271. suggested action: hold, pin current canary version, and run healthcheck. (reason: kube-apiserver 503s).

marta: oncall here. confirming, I'm seeing elevated 5xx from controlplane during prefix-replay. good call to pause.

ian: quick checklist — do we want a soft-rollback to the previous model binary or keep canary pinned and re-run cache-replay with throttling?

liz: my vote is pin-and-prove. pin the canary image that passed preflight, then disable the replay job and let traffic settle for 15m. if errors drop, we can attempt a gated replay with rate limit.

sean: +1 pin-and-prove. capture deploy notes and flag for postmortem. I'll add a release-note entry: "paused due to eu controlplane cache-replay causing 5xx; pinned canary v2.3.1-candidate"

ops-sre-bot: ACTION: pin applied -> service/renderer image=renderer:v2.3.1-candidate (pinned by sean).

marta: running quick smoke: `kubectl -n canary rollout status deploy/renderer --timeout=90s`

ian: logs look cleaner after pin. error rate down from 12% -> 1.2% over 5m. still seeing occasional spikes tied to replay cron.

sean: OK next steps proposal: 1) keep window paused for 30m, 2) block replay job (`kubectl patch cronjob replay -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}'`), 3) re-run a throttled replay at 10% rate behind feature flag, 4) if stable, resume release with a staggered rollout and explicit note in release notes.

liz: +1. also add rollback cut: who owns rollback if we see recurrence during throttled replay? tag oncall.

marta: i'll own rollback. rollback command: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/renderer -n canary --to-revision=3` (tested). posting to ops-runbook.

deploybot: reminder: change window extension needed if release resumes after 04:30Z. please ack so releasebot can adjust schedule.

sean: ack. extending window by 45m if we resume. adding `change-window: 45m` to release metadata.

ian: also note: add a perf-annotation to the release so Optimize team can re-eval batching/kvcache heuristics for replay-heavy workloads.

sean: done. tagging @optimize for follow-up.

ops-sre-bot: Incident INC-8271 created and linked to thread. postmortem assignee: marta.

marta: starting replay suspend now, will monitor for 20m and then coordinate throttled replay test. will update this thread with timestamps and test artifacts. :thumbsup:

sean: thanks. leaving deploy slot paused. will craft a short release-note blurb and a post-action checklist once we confirm stability.

(deploybot message): slot paused at 1708932100, awaiting manual resume.

sean: updating release notes draft: "Release paused due to eu controlplane replay-induced 503s. Canary pinned to renderer:v2.3.1-candidate. Replay suspended and will be retried with throttling. See INC-8271 for timeline."

marta: update at 1708932460: errors down, throttled replay test scheduled in 10m. will report outcome.
